<style>
    .comm-section-container:has(.slds-global-actions__notifications) {
      width: 100% !important;
    }
    .comm-section-container:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      width: 100vw;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .columns-content:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .content-container:has(c-account-dashboard) {
      background: var(--nc-layout-content-bg, #fff);
    }

    :host(.arc-sidebar-collapsed) {
      --arc-sidebar-width: 56px;
      --slds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --slds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --slds-c-card-shadow: none;
      --slds-c-card-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --slds-c-card-footer-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --sds-c-card-radius-border: var(--div-radius-lg);
      --sds-c-card-shadow: none;
      --sds-c-card-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
      --sds-c-card-footer-color-border: var(--div-color-border);
    }
    .slds-card,
    .slds-card_boundary {
      border: var(--div-border-card);
      border-radius: var(--div-radius-lg);
      box-shadow: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .slds-card__header {
      border-bottom-color: var(--div-color-border);
    }
    .slds-card__footer {
      border-top-color: var(--div-color-border);
    }

    .slds-card {
      box-shadow: none !important;
      border-radius: var(--slds-g-radius-border-3, 12px) !important;
    }

    .notification-row .notification-text {
      font-family: var(--div-font-family-base) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .notification-row .titleName {
      font-family: var(--div-font-family-base) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-3, 1.5rem) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .titleName {
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .notification-text-title {
      font-weight: 600 !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .titleOptions {
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }

    .div-notification-container .notification-text,
    .div-notification-container .notification-age {
      color: var(--div-color-neutral-50) !important;
      font-size: var(--div-font-scale-base) !important;
    }
    
    search_results-navigation {
        --dxp-crm-search-border-radius: var(--div-control-radius) !important;
        --dxp-crm-search-box-shadow: none !important;
    }
    
    iframe html {
        background: #fff !important;
    }
    
    .div-notification-container .notificationPanel {
        border: var(--div-border-card) !important;
		overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: var(--div-radius-lg) !important;
    }
    
    .global-header-actions .column-content {
        flex-direction: row !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        gap: .75rem !important;
    }
    
    .global-header-actions .column-content > * {
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .desktop-direction-row {
        width: 100% !important;
    }
</style>
